name: Alpinolino
kurzbeschreibung: Alpinolino Westendorf at 1,770 metres on the Talkaser is an interactive alpine nature discovery park featuring sensory adventure trails for families.
preis: Park admission free; Alpenrosenbahn cable car ride applies fares
oeffnungszeiten: Open during cable car summer operating season late May to late October
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Alpinolino Westendorf, nestled at an elevation of 1,770 metres atop the Talkaser ridge in the Kitzbühel Alps, is an inspiring mountaintop discovery realm tailored to young explorers and families. Operating under the guiding theme 'Play, Investigate, and Marvel', the panoramic plateau surrounding the Alpenrosenbahn top gondola terminal transforms into a sprawling open-air nature laboratory. Engaging thematic trails encourage children and adults to uncover the hidden wonders of alpine wildlife, mountain ecosystems, and geological phenomena with hands-on sensory stations. The park's cheerful marmot mascot, 'Spoggolino', escorts young researchers across obstacle courses, wildlife track quizzes, tactile stations, and observation viewpoints. While youngsters compare their jumping prowess with mountain animals, adults savor breathtaking 360-degree vistas stretching from the Wilder Kaiser massif to the glaciated peaks of the Hohe Tauern.

Route & Anforderungen

The central element of the discovery park is the 'Himmelsteig' (Sky Path), a gentle 1.5-kilometre circular trail encircling the Talkaser and Choralpe summit (approx. 1 to 1.5 hours walking time, mild gradient). Completely accessible with sturdy all-terrain strollers, it features interactive highlights like the eagle's nest lookout, marmot burrow tunnels, and alpine soundboards. Families seeking a longer hike can continue along the 'Holzwurmweg' (Woodworm Trail), descending 3.5 kilometres through shaded forest to the gondola mid-station (approx. 2 hours walking time). Comfortable sneakers suffice for the top plateau path, whereas supportive hiking shoes with rubber tread are recommended for descending woodland trails.

Besuch & Anreise

Travel by car follows motorway A12 (exit Wörgl Ost) along federal routes B178 and B170 into the scenic Brixental Valley to Westendorf. Free car parking is abundant at the Alpenrosenbahn valley gondola station. Rail travelers take the Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) to Westendorf in Tirol station, located just a pleasant ten-minute stroll from the lift base. The comfortable gondola whisks guests in two continuous sections straight up to the Alpinolino.

Tipps

Arrive in the morning hours when sunlight bathes the southern slopes and wild marmots can frequently be spotted basking on rock outcrops beneath Choralpe. The sun terrace of the Talkaser mountain inn at the trailhead serves delicious Tyrolean cheese dumplings and fresh Kaiserschmarrn with panoramic views.
